controls.reason: Pure decision boundaries, practicality, and the right separation from I/O, time, randomness, state, and dependencies are architecture judgments.
Controllable interfaces can be tested for declared boundaries, but proving every clock, random source, identifier, scheduler, and external boundary was found is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every boundary in the approved nondeterminism inventory supports an injected or otherwise controlled test implementation.

controls.reason: Public and test-only APIs are statically identifiable, but stability and whether a contract improperly exposes internals require design and compatibility judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every tested behavior uses a declared public contract rather than an API marked test-only.

controls.reason: Important state, sufficient observability, and sensitive-data exposure require domain, privacy, and operational judgment.
Repeated identical runs cannot prove determinism across all scheduling, clocks, networks, process state, and rare seeds without exhaustive control of nondeterministic inputs.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Two runs can match while a race flakes on the thousandth run or teardown leaks a port only after failure. The evidence passes but deterministic execution is not established.

controls.reason: Static analysis can flag known global, singleton, cache, and import-initialization patterns, but hidden state and order dependence cannot be proven absent across arbitrary code.

deterministic_clauses.statement: The repository passes approved hidden-global and initialization-order detectors and the randomized-order test suite.

controls.reason: Replaceable dependency boundaries and faithfulness of fakes, simulators, or doubles require architecture and contract-semantics judgment.
Behavioral constraint sufficiency and false confidence from test doubles require semantic comparison with real dependencies.
Whether a test hook is necessary and cannot weaken production security or integrity requires security architecture and threat judgment.
Concise data creation, valid defaults, and expressive edge-state support are developer-usability and domain-model judgments without fixed thresholds.
Injection capabilities are testable, but material boundary selection and complete failure-mode coverage require risk and architecture judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every boundary declared material supports tested failure, timeout, cancellation, retry, and partial-response injection.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Testability > Category-specific universal rules (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:373). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Asynchronous, queue, and eventual-consistency tests wait on declared state predicates rather than fixed delays.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Make asynchronous completion, queues, and eventual consistency waitable by state rather than arbitrary delay.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Declared scenarios can omit components and paths, while successful correlation fixtures do not prove propagation through retries, queues, and failures.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Normal requests can preserve IDs while a retry worker drops correlation. Listed scenarios pass but cross-component verification is not universally stable.

controls.reason: Cohesion enough to localize failures is a design and diagnosability judgment with no objective unit-size or localization threshold.
Known network calls and concurrency primitives can be detected, but complete nondeterminism and proper lower-level test boundaries require contextual analysis.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Lower-level tests pass the approved external-network ban and repeated concurrency-stability checks.

controls.reason: One dry-run, checkpoint, and reconciliation scenario per job does not prove safe behavior across data, interruptions, concurrency, and partial effects.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A migration can resume after one checkpoint fixture while duplicating rows after a later crash. Tests pass but checkpoint and reconciliation support is incomplete.

controls.reason: Health and diagnostic endpoints can be probed, but importance, suitability, production safety, and sensitive output require operational and security judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared production diagnostic signal is reachable through its approved probe and passes its sensitive-output filter.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Testability > Category-specific universal rules (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:379). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every applicable test distinguishes the declared absence-of-work outcome from successful completion.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Ensure tests can distinguish absence of work from successful completion.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: The original control combines two different promises: computing test setup time and complexity, and using those measurements as design feedback. Exact elapsed time is mechanically computable, but no bounded reusable predicate can evaluate an arbitrary project-specific setup-complexity formula over resource and action collections, and whether the measurements justify a design change requires contextual engineering judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A suite can have authenticated start and finish timestamps plus a complete resource and action manifest while a recorded complexity value is copied from a default or computed by a formula that omits expensive setup work. A design log can then contain a nonempty keep decision without anyone using the measurements. Presence, digest, timing, and record checks all pass although the promised complexity measurement and design feedback are false.

controls.reason: Excessive private knowledge, brittle setup, and the appropriate production refactor require accountable design and maintenance judgment.
Stable semantics, shared change drivers, and the appropriate point to extract reuse are architecture and domain judgments.
Cohesion and independence from consumer-specific workflow are semantic architecture properties not decidable from dependency counts alone.
Documentation fields do not prove complete or correct inputs, outputs, errors, side effects, ownership, and extension semantics for reusable units.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A library can list generic error and no side effects while writing global state. Every field exists but the public contract is false.

controls.reason: Genuine variation and incompatible responsibilities require semantic design judgment; configuration count cannot decide them.
Defaults and invalid-combination tests are objective, but whether defaults are safe requires risk and domain judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every configuration schema declares defaults and rejects every combination marked invalid in its versioned constraint set.

controls.reason: Proving no consumer terminology, permission, tenant context, or data leaks into a shared contract requires complete semantic and information-flow knowledge.
Dependency visibility is inspectable, but minimality depends on design alternatives, maintenance cost, and required behavior.

Source context Code quality and implementation > Reusability in Code > Category-specific universal rules (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:396). The exact promise is to version and document compatibility commitments, so an authenticated immutable policy record bound to each reusable component and version is authoritative; runtime compatibility is not claimed by this rule.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every reusable component has an immutable versioned compatibility-policy record that documents its current supported, unsupported, deprecated, and breaking-change commitments and binds those commitments to exact component versions.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A component can have a compatibility document with no version, omit which component release it governs, or overwrite prior commitments. Requiring immutable policy versions and exact component-version bindings rejects each false pass without claiming the documented behavior is effective.

controls.reason: Example and unsupported-use guidance presence is objective, but ordinary use and guidance clarity require consumer-context judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every reusable component provides at least one supported-use example and an unsupported-use guidance section.

controls.reason: Execution results are objective, but supported-context completeness and representative integration selection require product and consumer judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every supported context and every integration in the approved representative matrix has a current test result.

controls.reason: A consumer registry cannot prove completeness across copied, transitive, external, and dormant consumers, and send evidence does not prove receipt.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every registered consumer can receive notices while an untracked service remains vulnerable to a security fix. Both clauses pass but communication coverage is incomplete.

controls.reason: Whether a global utility lacks a meaningful domain boundary and should be avoided is semantic design judgment, though owner fields alone are insufficient.
Choosing local duplication over shared abstraction requires comparing domain independence and coordinated-change cost, not a mechanical duplication rule.
Defect, effort, inconsistency, and maintenance-cost metrics can be collected, but causal attribution to reuse requires analytical judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every shared abstraction has versioned defect, effort, inconsistency, and maintenance-cost measurements before and after reuse.

controls.reason: Fork and replacement procedures can be documented and exercised, but clarity and when governance no longer serves consumers require judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every shared component has a documented fork or replacement procedure and exportable current source or interface artifacts.

controls.reason: Static usage graphs can find known unused exports, but external or dynamic consumers make complete unused status unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every export or variant classified unused by the approved consumer inventory is removed or has a retention exception.

controls.reason: Context-aware security and validation behavior versus universal permissiveness requires threat, authorization, and domain judgment.
Internal implementation exposure and reuse convenience are semantic API-design and intent judgments.
Hidden coupling and fragile override behavior in inheritance or mixins require semantic change and architecture analysis.
Owner fields, policies, documents, and lifecycle states do not prove product-like support, accountable ownership, or useful documentation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A component can name an inactive owner and a support policy of best effort while all fields pass. Reuse is not actually managed as a product.

controls.reason: Balancing correctness, security, privacy, safety, accessibility, recoverability, elegance, reuse, and brevity is an accountable cross-quality decision.
These engineering principles are explicitly context-sensitive heuristics, so mechanical universal enforcement would contradict the control.
Justification records are checkable, but identifying nontrivial mechanisms and evaluating the stated quality scenario require architecture judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every abstraction or mechanism marked nontrivial links to a quality-attribute or change-scenario justification.

controls.reason: The simplest sufficient design and preservation of necessary evolution paths require comparing alternatives and future constraints.
Determining whether YAGNI was invoked to omit a known requirement, control, migration, operation need, or foreseeable failure requires intent and semantic review.
Coincidental similarity and different change, ownership, lifecycle, authorization, or semantic drivers require domain and design judgment.
Whether repeated defects or synchronized changes warrant one authoritative abstraction is a causal maintenance and architecture judgment.
Excessive indirection and total cognitive load from SOLID-derived structure require human comprehension and maintenance judgment.
Optimizing for intent, correctness, safe change, and lifecycle cost rather than line count is an accountable design trade-off.
Equivalence of alternatives and evidence that a convention causes unacceptable defects or cost require accountable engineering judgment.
Trade-off records are objective, but recognizing principle conflicts and evaluating their resolution require architecture judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared principle conflict with latency, memory, safety, compatibility, auditability, or simplicity has a versioned trade-off record.

controls.reason: Review scope fields can include boundaries and flows, but meaningful review beyond functions or classes requires human architecture assessment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every applicable engineering-principle review records assessed system boundaries and data flows.

controls.reason: Seven specification fields do not prove complete externally observable behavior or coherent contracts across all public operations.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A contract can omit a side effect or state transition while filling every category with generic text. Presence passes but behavior is not testably specified.

controls.reason: The invariant inventory may omit real invariants, and a mechanism label does not prove that it actually enforces the invariant.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An authorization invariant can be linked to monitoring only, or a financial invariant omitted. Every record passes while enforcement is absent.

controls.reason: Invalid-state completeness and where unconstructability or immediate rejection is practical depend on domain modeling and implementation cost.
Domain-rule independence and inherent coupling to presentation, transport, storage, or vendors are semantic architecture judgments.
Contract and naming fields are inspectable, but applicability and completeness of units, coordinates, currencies, time, precision, encoding, normalization, and ordering are contextual.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every domain value in the approved semantics inventory declares its applicable unit, coordinate, currency, time zone, precision, encoding, normalization, and ordering.

controls.reason: Applicability and correct behavior for fifteen edge classes depend on domain semantics, and generic entries can hide missing cases.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A balance contract can mark underflow not applicable and say error for all fields. The schema passes while behavior is not meaningfully specified.

controls.reason: Domain semantics and complete entry-point inventories require judgment, while a property suite cannot exhaust every value and implementation path.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known entry points can agree on ordinary values while one import path hashes Unicode differently. Tests pass but semantics are inconsistent.

controls.reason: Business-invariant and entry-point inventories can omit rules or dynamic paths, and authoritative enforcement is a semantic design fact.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All declared entry points can reach one validator while an unlisted batch import bypasses it. Graph checks pass but the invariant is not universally enforced.

controls.reason: Complete promised effects and pending-state oracles are not exhaustively defined for all success paths, failures, and side effects.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An API can return success after writing the database but before emitting a required event omitted from the oracle. Tests pass while the promised effect is incomplete.

controls.reason: Failure scenario tests can reject known false-success paths, but proving absence across all defaults, swallowed errors, partial writes, caches, and statuses is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every failure scenario in the approved matrix returns a distinct failure state and leaves no declared success-only effect.

controls.reason: Independent comparison evidence is objective, but criticality, consequence, and when an oracle is warranted require domain and risk judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every calculation marked independent-verification-required has a current oracle, reconciliation, property, model, or second-implementation result.

controls.reason: Declared external assumptions may omit dependencies, and an active test or monitor does not prove the assumption under all production states.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A provider timeout assumption can have a passing contract test while an undocumented ordering assumption fails. Records pass but external assumptions are not fully executable.

controls.reason: Source analysis cannot reliably identify all untrusted data and security decisions across reflection, generated code, libraries, and semantic policy boundaries.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Direct assertions can have validators while an indirect assertion remains the sole check for deserialized input. The analyzer passes but unsafe validation remains.

controls.reason: Conflict-domain completeness and correct precedence or tie-breaking depend on business semantics; deterministic syntax alone is insufficient.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A last-write rule can be documented for financial updates while losing valid data, or an unlisted conflict lacks policy. Records pass but resolution is not correctly defined.

controls.reason: Scenario-specific invariant tests are objective, but complete invariant and recovery-scenario coverage requires contextual and risk judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every invariant in the approved recovery matrix has current retry, replay, rollback, restore, migration, mixed-version, and disaster tests.

controls.reason: Aligning boundaries with capability, data, trust, scale, and change drivers is a multidimensional architecture judgment.
Repository source graphs can miss runtime loading, reflection, generated code, configuration, data, and infrastructure dependencies.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All parsed imports can obey direction while a plugin name or service call introduces a forbidden dependency. Static checks pass but architecture policy is violated.

controls.reason: Known framework and transport types can be detected crossing declared boundaries, but intentional contracts and semantic representation leakage require architecture review.

deterministic_clauses.statement: No type marked internal crosses a declared boundary unless it is listed in the boundary contract.

controls.reason: Minimizing mutating modules and invariant enforcers requires comparing designs and an undefined acceptable count.
Public-artifact inventories can omit objects, and identity plus lifecycle fields do not prove accountable ownership or valid policy.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All listed packages can have nominal owners while an unlisted dataset has none. Coverage passes but public artifacts remain unmanaged.

controls.reason: Smaller and more stable contracts are relative semantic and change-history properties with no fixed comparison threshold.
Cycle detection is bounded, but whether a cycle is unavoidable, the invariant is valid, and extraction is worse require architecture judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A harmful cycle can receive a signed exception claiming extraction worse. Graph and fields pass while the architecture rule is still violated.

controls.reason: Source analysis can find configured globals, service locators, and import side effects, but deciding preferable dependency style and hidden context completeness needs design judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every dependency source flagged hidden by the approved analyzer has an explicit injection or parameterization path or reviewed exception.

controls.reason: Where separating policy from mechanism or logic from effects improves verification and reuse is explicitly contextual architecture judgment.
Data ownership, behavior co-location, and stronger boundary violations require semantic architecture trade-off analysis.
Unrelated behavior and a utility area's effective domain boundary are semantic ownership and design judgments.
High-risk classification and meaningful coupling or coordination measures require architecture and measurement judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A risky component can be labeled low risk, or metrics calculated from only direct imports. Records pass while required high-risk measurements are absent.

controls.reason: Boundary test execution is objective, but representative integration-path selection and sufficient independent coverage require contextual judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared boundary has isolated contract tests and current results for each integration path in the approved representative matrix.

controls.reason: Alignment of failure containment with ownership and recovery is a socio-technical architecture judgment.
Understanding a stable common concept rather than matching syntax is a semantic abstraction judgment.
A semantic contract, accountable owner, compatibility policy, and consumer tests require substantive meaning and test adequacy beyond references.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A shared abstraction can link generic docs and smoke tests while omitting concurrency semantics. Fields pass but its contract is unclear.

controls.reason: Whether composition is preferable and inheritance exposes fragile details requires architecture and change analysis.
Narrowness, permission awareness, and real-use-case bounds for extension points are semantic design and authorization judgments.
Consumer records are checkable, but speculative genericity and which configuration, plugin, or type parameters constitute unsupported generality require design judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared extension or generic parameter marked production-supported links to at least one demonstrated consumer.

controls.reason: Choosing temporary duplication over sharing requires comparing domain independence, volatility, coupling, and materiality.
Which security and privacy rules must be centralized because divergence creates risk requires threat, domain, and authorization judgment.
Fundamentally different latency, failure, transaction, ownership, or consistency semantics and a misleading common interface are semantic design judgments.
Safe defaults and difficulty of incorrect use require domain, threat, and developer-usability judgment, not only API shape checks.
Documentation fields cannot prove complete or correct thread safety, reentrancy, lifetime, mutation, blocking, side-effect, and error guarantees.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A unit can declare thread-safe while sharing mutable state. All fields pass but the reusable contract is false.

controls.reason: Consumer test results are objective, but multiple and representative consumer selection requires usage and integration judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every reusable component has current tests against each consumer in the approved representative matrix, including a consumer other than the original.

controls.reason: Version policy and migration artifacts are observable, but conservative versioning and sufficient migration support require compatibility and consumer judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every shared-component breaking change increments the declared compatibility version and includes migration support artifacts.

controls.reason: Attributing reduced total change and defect cost to reuse requires causal analysis and a maintenance-cost model not defined here.
Unused generality and whether an abstraction's maintenance cost exceeds value are product and architecture judgments.
Terminology occurrences and glossary entries can be compared, but semantic consistency and which terms are nonobvious or contested require domain judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every term marked nonobvious or contested appears in the versioned glossary, and approved domain terms pass the terminology checker.

controls.reason: Meaningful naming versus storage type, mechanism, or historical accident is semantic and domain-specific.
Whether omitted units, scope, state, direction, or sensitivity can cause misuse requires domain and security risk judgment.
Ambiguity, overload, misleading humor, temporariness, and context dependence in names are semantic readability judgments.
One abstraction level, practicality, obscured intent, and appropriate extraction require human code comprehension.
Whether guard structure reduces nesting without hiding cleanup or transaction behavior is a code-review trade-off.
Control flow explicit enough for review is a human comprehension property, despite exits and effects being statically enumerable in some languages.
Readable intermediate values and exposure of assumptions or diagnostic value require human code-reading judgment.
Whether comments match behavior, merely repeat syntax, or preserve obsolete history is semantic code and history interpretation.
Rationale references can be required, but surprising constraints and sufficient explanations require reviewer judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every item marked surprising in the approved review record links to a why-oriented explanation or decision reference.

The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every temporary workaround references a decision or issue identifier and defines removal conditions.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist > Expanded gap-closure controls > Naming, readability, and cognitive load (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:496). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: All assessed source files match the output of the repository's pinned formatter configuration.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Apply stable automated formatting so reviews focus on behavior rather than style churn.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Focused change scope, coherent splitting, and improved review confidence require accountable change-design judgment.
Whether another qualified engineer can explain critical code, failures, and invariants is a comprehension exercise without defined qualification or success criteria.
State ownership and lifecycle fields are objective, but materiality and minimization of mutable shared state require architecture judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every state item marked material records owner, lifetime, synchronization, and persistence semantics.

controls.reason: Correct state category depends on domain meaning; a closed enum validates labels but not whether state is source, derived, cache, workflow, or presentation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A durable account balance can be labeled cached and pass enum checks while the architecture treats it incorrectly.

controls.reason: Reliability and affordability of derivation versus duplicated storage require performance, consistency, and architecture trade-offs.
Necessary duplication and correct synchronization, reconciliation, invalidation, conflict, and repair behavior require system-specific judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A duplicated balance can say last write wins and pass fields while losing updates. The relationship is documented but unsafe.

controls.reason: Explicit effect boundaries and where separation from pure transformations is practical require semantic architecture judgment.
Injected interfaces and tests are observable, but deciding when deterministic testing matters and finding every external effect require context and complete scope.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every nondeterministic input declared material is passed through a controllable interface with a test implementation.

controls.reason: Time-value inventories can omit values, and correct classification among six time concepts depends on semantic use.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A processing timestamp can be labeled event time and pass the enum, or a hidden wall-clock duration remains. Records pass but the time model is inconsistent.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist > Expanded gap-closure controls > State, effects, time, and determinism (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:509). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: No elapsed-duration calculation in the approved source model subtracts jumpable wall-clock timestamps.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Never infer elapsed duration from a wall clock that may jump.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Applicability, tolerable skew, and authoritative time sources require domain and distributed-system judgment; inventories can omit decisions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known token paths can have thresholds while billing or audit paths are omitted or use unsafe sources. Fields pass but time assumptions are incomplete.

controls.reason: Seed use and secure-random APIs are inspectable, but complete classification of security-sensitive values requires security context.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Tests and experiments record explicit seeds, and values marked security-sensitive use only approved cryptographic random sources.

controls.reason: Round-trip and compatibility tests cannot exhaust semantic values, versions, precision edges, and unknown-field interactions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Examples can pass while a large decimal loses precision or an old consumer drops an unknown field. The suite passes but meaning is not preserved.

controls.reason: Restart, retry, replay, and resume interleavings and irreversible side effects are not exhausted by selected scenarios.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A payment fixture can deduplicate simple retries while a crash after charge before recording repeats the charge. Tests pass but irreversible effects duplicate.

controls.reason: Complex-workflow identification and model completeness are contextual, while generated transitions do not cover unmodeled roles, guards, data, and concurrency.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The table can omit cancellation after timeout, making generated tests pass. Illegal behavior remains because the expected model itself is incomplete.

controls.reason: Ordering and tie-break tests are objective, but deciding where nondeterminism would harm users, signatures, caches, or reconciliation requires context.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every output marked deterministic-order-required has an explicit ordering and tie-break rule with current tests.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist > Expanded gap-closure controls > Error handling, cancellation, and recovery (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:519). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: The error taxonomy distinguishes invalid input, authorization denial, conflict, absence, timeout, cancellation, dependency failure, exhaustion, invariant violation, and unexpected defect.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Define an error taxonomy that distinguishes invalid input, authorization denial, conflict, absence, timeout, cancellation, dependency failure, resource exhaustion, invariant violation, and unexpected defect.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Cause, context, correlation, and retry metadata can be tested, but sensitive-internal exposure and sufficient context require security and user-interface judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared error preserves cause, operation context, correlation, and retryability internally while passing the approved public redaction assertions.

controls.reason: Which layer has enough context to recover, translate, compensate, communicate, or propagate is semantic architecture judgment.
Whether a broad catch continues in an unknown or corrupted state depends on semantics of the caught failures and recovery logic.
Static and runtime checks can identify discarded errors, but whether a cleanup or asynchronous failure affects correctness requires domain judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every error path marked correctness-affecting is propagated, recorded, or handled through an approved recovery path.

controls.reason: Retry limits and telemetry are objective, but safe repeatability of an operation requires side-effect and domain judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every retry policy declares attempt bound, observability, and an idempotency or safe-repeat contract.

controls.reason: Backoff, jitter, deadline, and budget settings are inspectable, but preventing overload and meeting user expectations require workload and user thresholds.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every retry policy defines backoff, jitter, deadline, and retry budget values.

controls.reason: Cancellation propagation tests are objective, but where work should stop requires operation-specific semantics.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every call path marked cancellation-propagating passes cancellation and deadline signals across all declared internal and external edges.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist > Expanded gap-closure controls > Error handling, cancellation, and recovery (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:527). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every partial-work contract defines behavior for request cancellation, worker termination, and dependency timeout.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Define what happens to partial work when a request is canceled, a worker terminates, or a dependency times out.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Compensation retry and reconciliation tests are objective, but proving true rollback impossible and choosing compensation require architecture judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every compensation path has current retryability and reconciliation test evidence.

controls.reason: User-actionable errors and sufficient protected diagnostic context require content, support, security, and usability evaluation without fixed criteria.
Expected high-volume flow and harm to clarity or performance require workload, code, and benchmark context.
Source failures and translation paths can be dynamic or unbounded, and a declared matrix can omit distinct failures.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Listed errors can map correctly while an unlisted storage conflict becomes 200 success. Tests pass but misleading translation remains.

controls.reason: Five scenario labels do not define fault timing, state, data integrity, duration, concurrency, and recovery oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A tiny restart test can pass while partial commit under another interruption corrupts data. The suite is green but recovery is not verified.

controls.reason: Finite-resource inventories can omit handles, and correct ownership, sharing, timeouts, cancellation, and cleanup semantics require implementation judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All listed resources can have fields while a generated file handle leaks or transfer semantics are wrong. Records pass but lifecycle is incomplete.

controls.reason: Exit modes and acquisition paths can be numerous, nested, and dynamically generated; selected injected cases cannot prove universal cleanup.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Normal fixtures can release resources while an exception between two acquisitions leaks the first. Tests pass but structured cleanup is incomplete.

controls.reason: Configured resource limits are measurable, but proving every resource was inventoried and bounds are sufficient requires architecture and capacity judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every resource in the approved inventory has an enforced numeric bound.

controls.reason: Scarcity, slow or unbounded calls, necessity, and justification require performance and correctness trade-off judgment.
Documentation presence does not prove correct concurrency guarantees or cover every concurrent unit and execution boundary.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A unit can declare atomic and visible while an implementation race violates both. Fields pass but guarantees are false.

controls.reason: One coherent synchronization or transaction strategy and complete shared-invariant protection require semantic concurrency analysis.
Lock ordering and held regions are analyzable, but the narrowest scope compatible with correctness requires design judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every lock class has a declared global ordering and passes the approved cycle detector.

controls.reason: Which execution contexts must remain responsive and whether a blocking operation violates their budget require runtime and architecture context.
Producer-consumer inventories can omit boundaries, and one overload fixture cannot prove backpressure behavior across timing and failures.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Listed queues can be bounded while an unlisted retry channel grows forever, or a race drops work before the limit. Both clauses pass but backpressure is incomplete.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist > Expanded gap-closure controls > Resources, concurrency, asynchronous work, and transactions (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:545). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every nonauthoritative timeout result is represented as uncertain and links to reconciliation behavior.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Treat timeouts as uncertain outcomes when the remote side may have completed the operation.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Repeatable-message inventories and duplicate tests cannot exhaust crash points, concurrency, replay windows, and side effects.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Sequential duplicates can deduplicate while a crash after effect before key storage repeats work. Tests pass but repeated requests remain unsafe.

controls.reason: A proof reference does not establish an end-to-end exactly-once proof, and channel delivery semantics can be incomplete or misleading.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A channel can declare exactly once and link to a broker guarantee that excludes consumer side effects. Fields pass but the claim has no end-to-end proof.

controls.reason: Alignment of transaction boundaries with business invariants and excessive duration across unreliable dependencies require semantic and performance judgment.
Concurrency mode and conflict result fields are observable, but deliberate strategy choice and clarity to users require design and usability judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every concurrent update contract declares optimistic or pessimistic strategy and exposes a distinct conflict result.

controls.reason: Named concurrency classes do not define exhaustive interleavings, durations, loads, resources, or complete outcome oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A suite can exercise one race and one deadlock fixture while a different lock order deadlocks under load. All labels appear but concurrency safety is not proven.

controls.reason: Proving every external, cross-process, tenant, stored, queued, cached, imported, and deserialized value is validated for its use requires complete information-flow knowledge.
Proving authorization at every trusted operation with all current context is a system-wide security property beyond bounded source and test evidence.
Known decision sites can be located, but proving no client-only or caller-controlled authentication, authorization, validation, privacy, or audit decision exists is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every decision site in the approved security inventory executes within a declared trusted boundary.

controls.reason: Complete safe parameterization and context-specific encoding across every interpreter and data flow is an open-ended security property.
Complete constraint of all attacker-influenced destinations, redirects, DNS, paths, and parsers requires whole-system taint and threat knowledge.
Approved-library and algorithm-policy checks are deterministic for known calls, but complete cryptographic use and caller influence require specialist review.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every cryptographic call in the approved source and dependency model uses an approved maintained library and allowed fixed algorithm or mode.

controls.reason: Secret-dependent side channels and materiality require specialized cryptographic, timing, cache, and threat analysis.
Minimizing personal and confidential data across collection, retention, copying, logging, tracing, caching, indexing, and exposure requires privacy and purpose judgment.
Proving every sensitive value is redacted or tokenized before all generic diagnostic and support systems requires complete data classification and flow coverage.
Proving no cross-user, tenant, request, job, cache, log, or task security-context inheritance occurs is a system-wide negative isolation claim.
Least privilege for code, jobs, tests, migrations, and utilities requires authorization, operational, and risk judgment beyond permission counts.
Dangerous API classification and whether types, capabilities, validation, and gates make accidental use hard are security design and developer-usability judgments.
Fail-closed confidentiality and deliberate availability fallback design require accountable security, reliability, and product trade-offs.
Defect-to-test links are objective, but materiality and whether a regression test fully captures the security or privacy defect require specialist judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every defect marked material security or privacy has a current regression test linked to the defect record.

controls.reason: Critical-operation completeness and appropriate performance requirements or budgets require product and system judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All listed operations can have preoptimization budgets while an omitted critical batch is optimized blindly. Records pass but the rule is unmet.

controls.reason: Profiler results are objective, but representativeness and whether a measured cost is dominant require workload and performance judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every optimization decision links to profiling measurements from the approved representative workload.

controls.reason: Acceptable worst-case behavior for adversarial and maximum inputs requires performance, safety, abuse, and product thresholds.
Configured limits and stress results are objective, but complete attacker-controlled input paths and sufficient bounds require threat and capacity judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every attacker-controlled dimension in the approved input inventory has an enforced computational, allocation, fan-out, query, decompression, parsing, or serialization bound.

controls.reason: Static and runtime profiles can flag repeated calls, parsing, scans, serialization, and per-item I/O, but whether repetition is accidental or harmful requires workload context.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every approved repeated-work detector and collection I/O benchmark is within its versioned budget.

controls.reason: Whether batching preserves latency, fairness, memory, failure isolation, and transaction semantics requires operation-specific performance and correctness judgment.
Cache inventories can omit layers, and correct keys, authorization scope, freshness, invalidation, bounds, and failure behavior depend on data semantics.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A cache can fill all fields while omitting tenant identity from its key. Records pass but authorization leakage remains possible.

controls.reason: Load tests can exercise stampedes, hot keys, cardinality, and data separation, but proving prevention across all workloads and identities is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every cache in the approved inventory passes its stampede, hot-key, cardinality-bound, and cross-user isolation tests.

controls.reason: Benchmark and profiling evidence presence is objective, but premature optimization and obscured correctness are design and comprehension judgments.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every non-obvious optimized code region links to benchmark and profiling evidence.

controls.reason: Performance test results are objective, but realistic skew, maximum objects, concurrency, and degradation scenario selection require workload and risk judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every scenario in the approved performance matrix has current cold, warm, skew, maximum-size, concurrency, and dependency-degradation results.

controls.reason: Regression measurements are deterministic under a pinned harness, but where stable measurement is possible requires platform and variance judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every benchmark marked stable runs automatically with algorithmic and allocation regression thresholds.

controls.reason: Full materialization, unacceptable memory or latency, and suitability of streaming require workload, algorithm, and architecture judgment.
Prompt release and useful lifetime of object graphs, closures, listeners, and caches depend on semantics, workload, and resource budgets.
Equivalence of product outcomes and trade-offs among energy, bandwidth, storage, and client-device cost require accountable product and performance judgment.
Control and observation hooks can be tested, but criticality and complete logic, dependency, side-effect, and failure-mode coverage require architecture judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every logic unit marked critical has tests controlling declared inputs, dependencies, time, randomness, side effects, and failure modes and observing outputs.

controls.reason: Meaningful behavior boundaries and private implementation trivia are semantic testing and design judgments.
Choosing examples versus properties and determining a broad input space require domain and test-design judgment.
Whether ordinary examples leave material risk and which advanced verification technique fits require risk and test-method judgment.
When independent models or oracles are warranted for parser, financial, cryptographic, migration, and other logic requires domain and consequence expertise.
Fault-seeding and mutation results are objective, but intended defect mapping and selective use require test-design and risk judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every test selected for effectiveness validation fails when its linked deliberate defect or approved mutation is introduced.

controls.reason: Whether a mock mirrors implementation details and fails to represent a real dependency contract is semantic test-double judgment.
Contract-test results are objective, but representative emulator, sandbox, or test-instance selection requires dependency and risk judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every external system in the approved matrix has current contract tests against its declared emulator, sandbox, or test instance.

controls.reason: Fixture minimality, validity, isolation, determinism, and representativeness of production edge conditions combine semantic and empirical judgments.
Cleanup and randomized-environment tests are objective, but proving no order, state, locale, speed, or network dependence exists is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every test suite passes cleanup checks and repeated randomized order, state, time-zone, locale, speed, and network-isolation executions.

controls.reason: Flaky-test issue classification and retry settings are observable, but root-cause completeness and whether retries are normalized require engineering judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every test classified flaky has a product-defect record and no unapproved permanent retry-only disposition.

controls.reason: Requirement-to-evidence links are deterministic, but criticality and complete identification of untested assumptions require risk and semantic judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every requirement and risk marked critical links to current verification evidence and an explicit assumption register.

controls.reason: Consequence, tractability, and justified choice among static analysis, proof, models, and runtime verification require accountable technical judgment.
Independent review of proofs, models, generators, oracles, and safety claims is explicitly a qualified human assurance decision.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every release verification result is bound to the built artifact digest and deployed configuration version rather than source units alone.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Test the built and configured artifact, not only source-level units.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. controls.reason: Which decisions, transitions, calls, retries, security events, and outcomes require telemetry depends on business, security, and operational risk.

The strengthened clauses compare the complete released schema history and require emitted telemetry to carry a resolvable schema version, rather than trusting one current schema record.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Across the complete ordered release history, every telemetry event identity resolves to retained versioned schemas whose event name, field identifiers and definitions, units, stable identifiers, and severity remain byte-identical within a version; any changed meaning uses a new version and no identifier is reassigned to a different meaning.

Authenticated telemetry fixtures for every current event type emit the declared event identity and schema version, and every emitted field decodes against that exact retained schema without unknown or conflicting names, identifiers, units, or severity.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A current schema can list all required fields while an older release used the same identifier for a different unit, or runtime events can omit the schema version. One schema record passes falsely; complete release-history comparison and emitted-event decoding fail both cases.

controls.reason: Correlation propagation and caller identifier validation are testable for declared flows, but complete distributed-flow coverage and trust boundaries require security judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every flow in the approved distributed-work inventory propagates correlation and causation using validated internal identifiers.

controls.reason: Failure telemetry fields are inspectable, but importance and sufficient distinction by cause and operation require operational judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every failure marked important records cause, operation, dependency, tenant, release, and retryability.

controls.reason: Proving telemetry has no secret, personal, attacker-controlled, high-cardinality, or unbounded field requires complete classification and all-path coverage.
Injected logging failure tests can detect declared effects, but proving logging never changes behavior, exhausts resources, or deadlocks is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every declared logging failure and saturation scenario preserves business results and stays within resource and liveness budgets.

controls.reason: Rare critical events and unbiased interpretation require statistical sampling design and business-impact judgment.

The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every audit record is stored with tamper-evident integrity controls.
Audit and debug schemas use distinct event classes and retention policies.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Make audit records tamper-resistant and semantically distinct from ordinary debug logs where accountability is required.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Enough reconstruction context and prohibited data boundaries require operational, privacy, legal, and security judgment.
Declared telemetry and trace tests can omit paths, data conditions, and alert delivery failures; successful queries do not prove behavioral coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known traces can propagate while a queue retry loses context or a dashboard query silently drops a tenant. Tests pass but telemetry behavior is wrong.

controls.reason: Telemetry-pipeline failures and deliberate degradation outcomes are not exhaustively defined across partial outages, backpressure, corruption, and recovery.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A full outage fixture can alert while partial lag silently drops events or overloads the app. The test passes but pipeline failure is not safely observable.

controls.reason: Static detectors and approval records cover known instrumentation, but temporary status, sensitivity, and complete probe discovery require context and unbounded scope.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every detected debug log, probe, or sensitive instrument is removed before production or links to an explicit approval.

controls.reason: Configuration schema fields are objective, but materiality and correct sensitivity or scope classification require domain and security judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every configuration value marked material defines schema, type, range, default, owner, sensitivity, environment scope, and reload behavior.

controls.reason: Malformed syntax is bounded, but contradictory, stale, insecure, and safely failed configuration require policy and threat judgment; the matrix can omit cases.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known invalid files can fail closed while a stale credential or contradictory cross-file value starts normally. Tests pass but unsafe activation remains.

controls.reason: Risky-behavior and provider inventories require security judgment, while outage tests cannot cover every fallback and cached state.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Listed risky flags disable on vault outage while an unlisted admin feature defaults on. Tests pass but missing control service enables risk.

controls.reason: Flag matrix tests are objective, but materiality and exhaustive combination selection can be combinatorial and context-dependent.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every combination, transition, targeting rule, default, and rollback path in the approved material-flag matrix has a current result.

controls.reason: Exit-criteria satisfaction and stale-item inventories require lifecycle judgment, and absence from known source does not prove removal from all runtime paths.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A flag can be omitted from the registry or marked exit unmet forever, or remain in generated config. Static checks pass while obsolete paths remain.

The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every resolved build and runtime dependency matches its pinned version and verified integrity identity.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Pin and verify build and runtime dependencies sufficiently to prevent unexpected substitution.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Dependency surface, maintenance health, license, provenance, security history, performance, and exit cost require multidisciplinary adoption judgment.
Whether a wrapper creates a real boundary or ceremonial indirection is semantic architecture judgment.
Reproduction is objective, but trusted generator status, review path validity, diff policy, and complete generated-artifact inventory require accountable judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A malicious generator can be labeled trusted and reproduce a digest exactly, or a generated asset omitted. Both clauses pass while provenance is not trustworthy.

controls.reason: Source context Code quality and implementation > Universal Code Quality, Design, and Implementation Master Checklist > Expanded gap-closure controls > Configuration, flags, dependencies, and generated code (docs/engineering/05-code-quality-and-implementation.md:630). The existing atomic clauses retain the full original promise, use an authority capable of observing it, and require bounded complete evidence rather than a policy-existence shortcut.

deterministic_clauses.statement: No generated output differs from trusted regeneration unless its process explicitly permits and verifies preserved edits.

controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial checker that observes only a convenient field while leaving part of “Do not edit generated output manually unless the process explicitly preserves and verifies such changes.” broken would not satisfy the existing all-clause aggregation. Missing scope, stale evidence, omitted subjects, or a contradictory authoritative source must block rather than pass.

controls.reason: Test-result coverage is objective, but sufficient behavior, compatibility, security, and performance testing for each change requires risk judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every dependency, generator, or configuration change links to current behavior, compatibility, security, and performance test results.

controls.reason: Static and package usage graphs identify known unused dependencies, but dynamic and external uses prevent a complete unused-capability proof.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every dependency classified unused by the approved static and runtime inventories is removed or has a reviewed retention record.

controls.reason: Plan presence is objective, but criticality, unsupported status, proprietary lock-in, and single-maintainer risk require architecture and supplier judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every dependency marked critical and unsupported, proprietary, or single-maintainer has a replacement or migration plan.

controls.reason: Required change-description fields are objective, but materiality and sufficient explanations of risk, alternatives, rollback, data, and observability require review.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every change marked material records intent, scope, risk, alternatives, tests, deployment, rollback, data impact, and observability impact.

controls.reason: High-impact classification and relevant reviewer expertise across domain, security, privacy, accessibility, data, and operations require accountable judgment.
Meaningful review of callers, consumers, flows, concurrency, failures, and deployment context is a qualified human activity, not an artifact-presence check.
Mechanical checks are bounded, but materiality, reviewer independence, semantic adequacy, and risk judgment require accountable human decision.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An unauthorized second account can sign a boilerplate review while CI passes. Both clauses succeed but automation has substituted for real judgment.

controls.reason: Review size, latency, preserved attention, and coherent behavioral splitting require human factors and change-context judgment.
Consequential classification, complete dissent capture, and meaningful unresolved-question records require governance judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A major change can be labeled nonconsequential or dissent recorded as none despite objection. Fields pass but dissent is not preserved.

controls.reason: Technical-debt inventories can omit obligations, while cost, risk, evidence, outcomes, ownership, and repayment triggers require judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known debt can be relabeled design choice, or fields contain vague values and nominal owner. Records pass but future cost is not truthfully tracked.

controls.reason: Distinguishing technical debt from missing requirements, security defects, and production failures is semantic issue-triage judgment.
Characterization tests and specifications are observable, but poorly understood behavior and stronger-enough specification require engineering judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every refactor marked behavior-poorly-understood has characterization tests or a stronger versioned specification before change.

controls.reason: Behavior preservation, separation boundaries, and improved review or rollback are semantic change-design judgments.
Confirming no runtime, data, customer, or external dependency remains before dead-code deletion is an unbounded negative dependency claim.
Review difficulty, cognitive load, operational burden, and ownership are not objective metrics without defined protocols, and combining them still requires interpretation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A report can fill all seven fields with arbitrary scales while ignoring real maintenance pain. Presence passes but maintainability is not meaningfully measured.

controls.reason: Practicality, systemic prevention, and the right regression test after an escaped defect require root-cause and prioritization judgment.
Scheduling maintenance before deadlines, degradation, or knowledge concentration becomes an emergency requires forecasting and accountable prioritization.
Owner and documentation coverage is observable, but survivability through staff changes and independence from one person's knowledge require organizational judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every maintained code asset has active primary and backup owners and versioned documentation.

controls.reason: Test and contract links are objective, but criticality and whether invariants, authorization, failures, and data effects are adequately explained require review.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every code path marked critical documents invariants, authorization, failure modes, and data effects and links to current tests.

controls.reason: Compilers and analyzers can detect known undefined, race, overflow, and precision hazards, but critical-path status and complete absence require semantic review.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every critical path passes the approved undefined-behavior, race, overflow, and precision analyzers and tests.

controls.reason: Failure tests can detect declared corruption, duplicates, and false success, but proving absence across every error, timeout, retry, cancellation, and restart is unbounded.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every scenario in the approved interruption matrix preserves integrity, prevents duplicate irreversible effects, and returns a distinct non-success state.

controls.reason: Taint and cost analysis can find known untrusted paths and resource bounds, but complete reachability and exhaustion impact require threat and capacity judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every untrusted-input path in the approved model has enforced work and allocation bounds below shared-resource budgets.

controls.reason: Proving no code path logs any reusable secret, session, payment credential, or prohibited personal data requires complete data classification and flow coverage.
Critical classification and trusted source provenance require security and governance judgment even though reproduction and digest checks are bounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An unsafe dependency can be labeled noncritical, or a malicious source approved as trusted while outputs reproduce. Both clauses pass but a critical untraceable item can ship.

controls.reason: High-impact classification, required review, genuine independence, qualification, and approval authority cannot be established by different identity values alone.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An author can use a second account to approve or mark dangerous code low impact. Record checks pass while independent review is absent.

controls.reason: Evidence binding is objective, but materiality and complete preservation of required behavior and compatibility require semantic scope judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every refactor marked material has current behavior and compatibility evidence bound to before-and-after artifacts.

controls.reason: Waived-result inventories can omit suppressed findings, and nonempty technical disposition or owner fields do not prove valid justification and accountability.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A security failure can be relabeled warning then omitted, or waived with disposition acceptable and inactive owner. Fields pass while concern is dismissed improperly.

controls.reason: Determining that a quality claim relies solely on coverage, lint, complexity, style, or absence of known defects requires semantic interpretation of claims and reasoning.
Specification field presence does not prove complete behavior, quality attributes, constraints, or failure tolerances before implementation completion.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A service can define generic behavior and omit tenant failure tolerance while every section exists. The record passes but completion criteria are incomplete.

controls.reason: Resolvable graph links do not prove semantic traceability, and maintained-code or applicable-artifact inventories can omit units and relationships.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each file can link to generic requirements and tests while an authorization path has no relevant risk or contract. Graph checks pass but traceability is false.

controls.reason: Criticality labels and source mappings are observable, but complete identification across safety, security, privacy, accessibility, finance, integrity, and availability requires specialist judgment.

deterministic_clauses.statement: Every code unit classified critical is explicitly tagged with one or more named criticality domains.

controls.reason: Maintained-artifact inventories can omit generated or operational code, and active identities do not prove accountable ownership.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All listed packages can name owners while an unlisted production script has none, or the named account denies responsibility. Coverage passes without ownership.
